Rules for tactics combat:
At the beginning of the first round, roll a d4. Players will issue commands to their respective troops for as many rounds as the result on the die. Once all groups from both sides have set their orders, each unit makes an initiative check, determining the acting order for that series of rounds. Once the number of rounds rolled have passed, repeat the above process. Each side gets 1 of each unit.

Map key: 
Normal visibility is 30 feet due to the fog
Dark brown areas are swamps: difficult terrain for cavalry, all units must make a DC 14 CON save upon entering, taking 1d6 poison damage on a failure
Forest green is normal terrain: no effects
Light brown areas are sides of hills: difficult terrain to go up, half movement to go down, visibility increases by 10 feet
Light green areas are tops of hills: difficult terrain to go up, half movement to go down, visibility increases by 20 feet.
Hills obstruct line of sight and can be hidden behind.
